name: cipp-mcp
description: MCP server and CLI for CIPP - Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, Defender and GDAP across every client tenant, with an offline store, fleet posture analytics, and cross-tenant fan-out.

cipp_api_key.title: CIPP bearer token
cipp_api_key.description: Azure AD bearer JWT for your self-hosted CIPP instance. Obtained via OAuth2 client-credentials against login.microsoftonline.com; 'auth login' performs the exchange and caches it. CIPP_API_KEY accepts a static bearer token.

cipp_base_url.title: CIPP API base URL
cipp_base_url.description: Base URL of your self-hosted CIPP instance's API, e.g. https://cipp.example.com/api. The shipped default points at an example host, so until you set this the CLI is not talking to your tenant at all.

cipp_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
cipp_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk: auth login and auth set-token refuse and nothing is written, so supply the bearer token in CIPP_API_KEY. Leave blank for the default, which keeps the minted token in the credentials file.

cipp_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cipp_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on CIPP requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

cipp_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
cipp_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to drop every MCP tool not marked read-only, cipp_execute included. Leave blank to allow writes, which run only after a preview the agent confirms.

cipp_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
cipp_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to keep no local copy of CIPP data: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and fanout --save and --resume refuse to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

cipp_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cipp_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.
